scenes.text: This book is *600 years old* — and to this day, *no one has cracked* what it says.
It's called the *Voynich Manuscript:* 240 pages, thousands of words, in a script *nobody on Earth recognizes.*
In World War Two, the same *codebreakers* who cracked Nazi *Enigma* tried next — and *walked away empty-handed.*
Its pages show plants that *don't exist in nature,* strange star charts, and women bathing in *pools linked by pipes.*
A century of top cryptographers, linguists, and now *AI language models* have thrown everything at it. Confirmed words decoded: *zero.*
Every 'solved' claim since has been picked apart by scholars within *months.* The book always *wins.*
The book that *beat every expert* for 600 years straight. Follow for more *lost secrets* of history.
